examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

items.wordHook: 中(central) + 間(space) → the central space, meaning middle, between, among.

examples.chinese: 我現在有課，不能去他家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yǒu kè, bù néng qù tā jiā.
examples.english: I have class now, so I cannot go to his house.

examples.chinese: 這個禮拜我有很多功課，不能跟你去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng gēn nǐ qù wán.
examples.english: This week I have a lot of homework, so I cannot go out and have fun with you.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
examples.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

examples.chinese: 如果他不能接電話，你就留言吧！
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù néng jiē diànhuà, nǐ jiù liúyán ba!
examples.english: If he can't answer the phone, then leave a message!

examples.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: A:今天天氣很好，你怎麼沒出去？ B:今天我有很多功課，不能出去玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, nǐ zěnme méi chūqù? B: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng chūqù wán.
examples.english: A: The weather is so nice today; how come you didn't go out? B: I have a lot of homework today, so I can't go out and have fun.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 我還沒去過日本，今年可能有機會去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Rìběn, jīnnián kěnéng yǒu jīhuì qù.
examples.english: I have not yet been to Japan; this year I might have a chance to go.

examples.chinese: 今天辦公室的冷氣不冷，可能冷氣機有問題。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bàngōngshì de lěngqì bù lěng, kěnéng lěngqìjī yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: Today the air conditioning in the office is not cold; there might be a problem with the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子還太小，不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi hái tài xiǎo, bù néng hē jiǔ.
examples.english: This child is still too young, cannot drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，食物不能在外面放太久。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, shíwù bù néng zài wàimiàn fàng tài jiǔ.
examples.english: In summer, food cannot be left outside for too long.

examples.chinese: 美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。
examples.pinyin: Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.
examples.english: Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable.

examples.chinese:
大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。
雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin:
Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo.
Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english:
In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better.
Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese:
經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。
小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin:
Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo.
Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english:
The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well.
Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese:
東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。
我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin:
Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng.
Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english:
Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance.
My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese:
這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。
寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán.
Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english:
Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them.
Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer.

examples.chinese: 沒有人能保證上了有名的大學，未來就一定快樂、幸福。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng bǎozhèng shàngle yǒumíng de dàxué, wèilái jiù yīdìng kuàilè, xìngfú.
examples.english: No one can guarantee that if you get into a famous university, you will definitely be happy and blessed in the future.

examples.chinese: 吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese:
小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。
我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi.
Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english:
Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes.
My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 糟了！衣服被咖啡弄髒了，我得換一件才能出門。
examples.pinyin: Zāo le! Yīfu bèi kāfēi nòng zāng le, wǒ děi huàn yī jiàn cái néng chūmén.
examples.english: Uh-oh! My clothes got dirty from coffee; I have to change into another piece before I can go out.

examples.chinese:
因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。
這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō.
Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english:
Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast.
There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese:
因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。
不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le.
Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english:
Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.
Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese:
沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。
不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin:
Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi.
Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english:
No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well.
Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 小白喝了太多酒，已經醉了，不能讓他繼續喝了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bái hē le tài duō jiǔ, yǐjīng zuì le, bùnéng ràng tā jìxù hē le.
examples.english: Xiao Bai has drunk too much alcohol and is already drunk; we can't let him keep drinking.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese:
真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。
青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de.
Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english:
True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you.
Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese:
如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。
為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin:
Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn.
Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english:
If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test.
In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài jǐnggào Hán xiānsheng juéduì bù néng zài hējiǔ le, yàobùrán tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le.
examples.english: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han that he absolutely must not drink alcohol anymore; otherwise his physical condition would get worse.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese:
大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。
先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin:
Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě.
Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english:
Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand.
The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese:
這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。
老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù.
Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english:
In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds.
The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: 這支手機的照相功能很強，拍出來的效果比照相機還要好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī de zhàoxiàng gōngnéng hěn qiáng, pāi chūlái de xiàoguǒ bǐ zhàoxiàngjī hái yào hǎo.
examples.english: This phone's camera function is very strong; the effect of the photos taken is even better than that of a camera.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.
examples.english: That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese:
為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。
像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin:
Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān.
Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english:
In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries.
Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese:
科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。
網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin:
Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí.
Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english:
Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life.
The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 對某一些人來說，結了婚還能不能有其他情人，這是道德問題。
examples.pinyin: Duì mǒu yīxiē rén lái shuō, jié le hūn hái néng bù néng yǒu qítā qíngrén, zhè shì dàodé wèntí.
examples.english: For some people, whether one can still have other lovers after getting married is a moral issue.

examples.chinese:
由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。
那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin:
Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì.
Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english:
Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings.
That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

items.wordHook: a 䏍(secret flesh) grips a 匕(spoon) → showing what a strong body 能(can) do.

examples.chinese: 這個禮拜六我們學校有舞會，你要參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǐbàiliù wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu wǔhuì, nǐ yào cānjiā ma?
examples.english: This Saturday our school has a dance party; do you want to attend?

examples.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
examples.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

examples.chinese: 你明天有考試，要早一點起床喔！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, yào zǎo yīdiǎn qǐchuáng o!
examples.english: You have an exam tomorrow—you need to get up a little earlier, okay!

examples.chinese: 我送了一束玫瑰花給女朋友，一共有二十朵。這幾朵玫瑰花好漂亮喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sòng le yī shù méiguī huā gěi nǚpéngyǒu, yīgòng yǒu èrshí duǒ. Zhè jǐ duǒ méiguī huā hǎo piàoliang o!
examples.english: I gave a bouquet of roses to my girlfriend; there are twenty roses in total. These few roses are so pretty!

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: 室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu A: Hēi, chī wán fàn hòu bùnéng bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi zài zhuōzi ràng biérén xǐ o. Shìyǒu B: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zhè jiù qù xǐ. Shìyǒu A: Hēi, nǐ hái zhēn tīnghuà a.
examples.english: Roommate A: Hey, after eating you can't leave your bowls and chopsticks on the table for others to wash. Roommate B: Sorry, I'll go wash them right now. Roommate A: Hey, you really are obedient!

examples.chinese: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
examples.pinyin: A: Jiāng xiānsheng duì fùmǔ hěn xiàoshùn, gèxìng yòu wēnróu, jiānglái yīdìng shì hǎo xiānsheng. B: Zhè hái yòng shuō ma? Yàoshi nǐ duì tā yǒu yìsi, jiù děi zǎo diǎnr xíngdòng o!
examples.english: A: Mr. Jiang is very filial to his parents and has a gentle personality; in the future he will definitely be a good husband. B: You're telling me! If you're interested in him, you'd better make a move early!

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上我發燒，燒到三十九度，那種感覺非常不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ fāshāo, shāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù, nà zhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng bù shūfu.
examples.english: Last night I had a fever that went up to thirty-nine degrees, and that feeling was extremely uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 林明生躺在草地上看星星，他感覺真輕鬆。
examples.pinyin: Lín Míngshēng tǎng zài cǎodì shàng kàn xīngxing, tā gǎnjué zhēn qīngsōng.
examples.english: Lin Mingsheng lies on the grass looking at the stars; he feels truly relaxed.

examples.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
examples.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
examples.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
examples.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

examples.chinese: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yùndòng guò hòu, hē bēi bīngbīngliángliáng de lěngyǐn, gǎnjué hěn tòngkuài.
examples.english: After exercising in summer, drinking a glass of ice-cold cold drink feels very refreshing.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese:
小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。
經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english:
Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job.
After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 我有一個幸福美滿的家庭，父母都很愛我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge xìngfú měimǎn de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
examples.english: I have a happy and fulfilling family; my parents both love me very much.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。那個杯子裡裝滿了水。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以假日常常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: That restaurant's food is both cheap and delicious, so it is often fully occupied on holidays.

examples.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese:
張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。
我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà.
Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english:
Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily.
When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese:
臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。
A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin:
Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì.
A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english:
Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied.
A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
examples.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
examples.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

examples.chinese: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng duì nóngyè hěn yǒu xìngqù, jiālǐ de cāngkù bǎi mǎn le zhòngtián yòng de gōngjù.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very interested in agriculture; the warehouse at home is filled with tools for farming.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān yīnwèi bù shǎo rén fàngjià, dà bùfèn cāntīng dōu kèmǎn le.
examples.english: On New Year's Day, because many people had the day off, most restaurants were full.

examples.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
examples.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
examples.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese:
這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。
我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì.
Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english:
This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance.
My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 這首古老民謠的風格很獨特，不管大人小孩都會唱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gǔlǎo mínyáo de fēnggé hěn dútè, bùguǎn dàrén xiǎohái dōu huì chàng.
examples.english: The style of this ancient ballad is very unique; regardless of adults or children, everyone can sing it.

examples.chinese: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méi zhǔchí guò shénme jiémù, tā de dútè fēnggé réngrán yǐnqǐ dàjiā zhùyì.
examples.english: Although he has never hosted any programs, his unique style still attracted everyone's attention.

examples.chinese: 這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèidào dútè, xiāngwèi jí yánsè yě hěn mírén, ràng rén rěnbuzhù liú kǒushuǐ.
examples.english: This dish has a unique flavor, and its aroma and color are also very charming, making people unable to resist drooling.

examples.chinese: 這所國立大學獨特的教育風格吸引了不少國外學生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ guólì dàxué dútè de jiàoyù fēnggé xīyǐn le bùshǎo guówài xuéshēng.
examples.english: This national university's unique educational style has attracted quite a few foreign students.

examples.chinese: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
examples.pinyin: Měi miàn guóqí dōu dàibiǎo yī ge guójiā, érqiě shèjì shàng dōu jùyǒu dútè de yìyì.
examples.english: Every national flag represents a country, and each has a unique meaning in its design.

examples.chinese: 每個宗教都有屬於自己的獨特儀式。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge zōngjiào dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de dútè yíshì.
examples.english: Every religion has its own unique ceremonies.

examples.chinese: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn jīnpái shì wánquán yòng jīnzi zuò de, wàiguān yě xiāngdāng dútè.
examples.english: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and its appearance is also quite unique.

examples.chinese: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zuòshì fēicháng cūxīn, yīncǐ gōngsī yīzhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòngyào de yèwù jiāo gěi tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very careless in doing things, so the company has never dared to hand important business over to him.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
examples.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
examples.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
examples.pinyin: Xíngdòng bù fāngbiàn de chéngkè chéngchē shí, chēzhàn yǒu fúwùyuán wèi tāmen fúwù.
examples.english: When passengers with limited mobility ride the train, there are service staff at the station to serve them.

examples.chinese: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
examples.pinyin: A: Jiāng xiānsheng duì fùmǔ hěn xiàoshùn, gèxìng yòu wēnróu, jiānglái yīdìng shì hǎo xiānsheng. B: Zhè hái yòng shuō ma? Yàoshi nǐ duì tā yǒu yìsi, jiù děi zǎo diǎnr xíngdòng o!
examples.english: A: Mr. Jiang is very filial to his parents and has a gentle personality; in the future he will definitely be a good husband. B: You're telling me! If you're interested in him, you'd better make a move early!

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián bómǔ tuìxiū hòu, jiù dàizhe bófù dàochù qù lǚxíng le.
examples.english: Ever since my aunt retired last year, she has been taking my uncle traveling everywhere.

examples.chinese: 爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Bàba wèile yíngjiē bófù huí Táiwān guòjié, bǎ kèfáng dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: In order to welcome Uncle back to Taiwan for the holiday, Dad cleaned the guest room very clean.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

examples.chinese: 小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi gāng xuéxí yòng kuàizi chī miàntiáo shí, cháng xūyào māma xiān tì tā bǎ miàn bàn yī bàn.
examples.english: When little children first learn to eat noodles with chopsticks, they often need their mother to first mix the noodles for them.

examples.chinese: 她把蛋白拌進麵粉裡，加點兒花生烤一烤，又香又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dànbái bàn jìn miànfěn lǐ, jiā diǎnr huāshēng kǎo yī kǎo, yòu xiāng yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: She mixed the egg white into the flour, added some peanuts, and baked it; it's fragrant and delicious.

items.wordHook: One curved line hooks inward to touch itself → 己(self).
沙(shā) + 發(fā) mimic the sound of 'sofa' → this word means sofa.
氵(water) floods the 罙(cave with fire) until it is 深(deep).
Combining 驚(frighten) and 訝(amazed): 驚訝 means surprised.
